_why: A close-but-not-equal mel/DCT gives the right shape and the wrong answer. The Dart implementation is checked against these.
_relationship: librosa.feature.mfcc == DCT-II(norm='ortho') of power_to_db(melspectrogram, ref=1.0), verified to 1e-9 when this fixture was generated. ref=np.max (what MelSpectrogram.compute returns) shifts mfcc[0] by ref_offset_db and leaves mfcc[1..12] bit-identical.
_day332_added: shimmer/hnr/rms_mean/rms_std/rms_max, the five of the ten missing 38-vector features that need no pyin. librosa.feature.rms defaults center=True with constant(zero) padding of frame_length//2 each side, giving 1 + len(y)//hop = 188 frames for a 48000-sample clip. hnr is np.correlate(y,y,'full') kept from the centre, max(ac[1:320]) / ac[0] clipped to [0,1], where 320 = int(sr*0.02) -- computed on the UNPADDED signal, unlike rms.
_day332_indices: in the 38-vector these are [5] shimmer, [6] hnr, [33] rms_mean, [34] rms_std, [35] rms_max
